text:
maria (Eng): Hey team, quick Q — my claim for last week's visit to Lakeview Gastro (claim #987654321) was processed as OUT-OF-NETWORK. When I booked the office and on their site they show as in-network. Anyone seen this before? I attached the EOB and a screenshot of the insurer directory.
jamie (People Ops): Can you DM the EOB here? Also which plan are you on (PPO/HSA)?
maria (Eng): It's Redwood Core PPO (plan ID RW-PPO-2025). Uploaded screenshot of the UnitedCare provider listing — shows Lakeview Medical Group: Participating. Provider NPI 1234567890.
jamie (People Ops): Thanks. Two quick possibilities: 1) insurer sometimes matches on the provider tax ID / billing TIN rather than the NPI, so a billing office using a parent group's tax ID can trigger OON adjudication; 2) group participation can change between the date of booking and claim processing. I'll coordinate with our broker and open an appeal with UnitedCare. Can you attach the EOB PDF here in thread if you haven't already?
maria (Eng): Uploaded EOB.pdf
benefits-bot: Plan lookup: RW-PPO-2025 — UnitedCare Networks. Provider directory snapshot (2025-04-12): Lakeview Medical Group — Participating. Appeal instructions: call UnitedCare Provider Resolutions at 1-800-555-9012 or submit online: https://unitedcare.example/appeals. Reference Claim ID: 987654321.
jamie (People Ops): Next steps I'm taking: 1) confirm billing/tax ID with Lakeview billing (jamie -> Lakeview billing); 2) submit member appeal to UnitedCare with EOB + provider directory screenshot + appointment confirmation. I'll cc you on the insurer case. If UnitedCare still denies, we'll escalate with Harbor Benefits (our broker).
mike (Finance): FYI — if the appeal is pending and you have out-of-pocket burden, Finance can approve an interim reimbursement for urgent care items until resolution. Ping me directly if you want that.
maria (Eng): Thanks all! Jamie — please cc me. Also, do we have a short appeal template I can paste into their online form?
jamie (People Ops): Yep — paste below when you file or hand to the rep on the phone:

```
To Whom It May Concern,

I am requesting a review of the denial for Claim #987654321 (Provider: Lakeview Medical Group) for services dated 2025-04-10. I am enrolled in Redwood Core PPO (Member ID: XXXXXX). The UnitedCare directory lists Lakeview Medical Group as participating (screenshot attached). Please reprocess this claim as in-network and adjust member responsibility accordingly.

Attached: EOB, provider directory screenshot, appointment confirmation.

Thank you,
[Member Name]
```

maria (Eng): Perfect — submitting now and will paste the template in the online portal. Will report back here after I get a case number.
benefits-bot: Case created: UnitedCare Appeal ID UCARE-2025-0423-5567. Submitter: maria (Eng). Link: https://unitedcare.example/cases/UCARE-2025-0423-5567 (external link).
jamie (People Ops): Logged internal ticket HR-BEN-741 — will follow up with broker and Lakeview billing. I'll update this thread after I hear from Harbor Benefits.
maria (Eng): Appreciate it :pray:
